rationale: The agent did identify the user via name and ZIP, which could satisfy minimal authentication, and retrieved multiple order details. However, it executed several order-changing writes without explicit user confirmation: it both attempted an exchange and then a return on the same tablet item, canceled a pending order (likely the charger), and initiated a sneaker return. This violates the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, performing both exchange and return on the same item contradicts the user’s preference (exchange if available, otherwise return) and indicates incorrect action sequencing. There is no clear evidence the agent provided the tracking number. The user’s stated preference to handle one thing at a time was also disregarded. These issues fail the policy and completion criteria.
